landing.title: Swapping around you.
landing.description: Discover, exchange and meet locally. Troco turns forgotten objects into real-life local encounters.

simple.title: Simple
simple.text: List an item and suggest a swap in just a few clicks.

local.title: Local
local.text: Nearby exchanges, in person, in your own city.

sustainable.title: Sustainable
sustainable.text: Reuse instead of buying, throwing away or letting things sit unused.

negotiation.title: Suggest, adjust, meet.
negotiation.description: If the exchange does not feel balanced, each person can ask for a change, suggest something else or add an item to compensate.

step1.title: Suggest an item
step1.text: Pick one or several items from your library to start the exchange.

step2.title: Discuss and adjust
step2.text: The other person can accept, ask for compensation or suggest something else.

step3.title: Plan the meeting
step3.text: Once the swap is accepted, choose a time slot and a reassuring place.

why.title: Selling takes time. Giving is not always simple.
why.text: Many objects stay in our homes because we do not want to negotiate a price, handle unanswered messages or organize a complicated meetup. Troco turns those objects into exchange opportunities and local moments.

discovery.title: Turn what you no longer use into something new.
discovery.text: A pair of shoes can become a vinyl record. A forgotten lamp can find a new home. On Troco, value comes from desire.

unexpected.title: You do not need to swap like for like.
unexpected.text: Book for plant, jacket for camera, lamp for guitar… Troco opens the door to freer, more personal exchanges.

guided.title: The best swaps are built together.
guided.text: Add an item, suggest something else or refine the proposal. Here, we do not haggle: we find an exchange that feels right.

local.title: Objects create real encounters.
local.text: Choose a time, a reassuring place, then exchange in real life. Troco is designed to move beyond the screen and circulate objects locally.
